**Adding 4+4 decoder logic**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module decoder_8bit
#(
    parameter N = 8
) (
    input [N-1:0] in,
    output reg [(1<<N)-1:0] out
);
    generate
        if (N == 8) begin : g_predecode
            wire [15:0] low_miss;
            wire [15:0] high_miss;
            wire [255:0] decoded;

            for (genvar p = 0; p < 16; p = p + 1) begin : g_half
                localparam [3:0] CODE = p;
                assign low_miss[p] = |(in[3:0] ^ CODE);
                assign high_miss[p] = |(in[7:4] ^ CODE);
            end

            for (genvar h = 0; h < 16; h = h + 1) begin : g_high
                for (genvar l = 0; l < 16; l = l + 1) begin : g_low
                    assign decoded[16*h+l] = ~(high_miss[h] | low_miss[l]);
                end
            end

            always @(*) begin
                out = decoded;
            end
        end else begin : g_original
            always @(*) begin
                out = {{(1<<N)-1{1'b0}}, 1'b1} << in;
            end
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical path includes input buffering followed by AND2B, NAND4 and NOR4 stages. Decoder-wide fanout and the final four-input gate contribute to its 1.06 ns maximum arrival.",
  "rewrite": "Use two shared 4-to-16 active-low predecoders. Each output is a two-input NOR of the corresponding high-nibble and low-nibble mismatch signals. This exposes a shallow NAND4-to-NOR2 implementation with nominal predecode fanout of 16.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival by removing an intermediate logic stage and replacing the final NOR4 with NOR2. The actual gain depends on ABC factoring, buffering and sizing; no mapped timing result is available for this candidate.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The intended structure uses 32 four-input predecode functions and 256 two-input output gates, plus input inversions and buffering. It is expected to fit the 2859.992960 um2 area cap, but mapped area and zero max-slew/max-capacitance violations require verification in the specified flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For N=8, decoded[16*h+l] is asserted exactly when in[7:4] equals h and in[3:0] equals l, matching every bit of the original one-hot shift for all 256 binary inputs. Module name, parameter default, port widths and unsigned declarations are preserved. Other parameter values retain the original expression. The design is entirely combinational and introduces no assumptions or undefined outputs."
}
